item.title: Football fans are wagering millions on the Super Bowl in Texas where gambling is illegal
item.description: DALLAS – Gambling is illegal in Texas, but it’s not stopping football fans from wagering millions of dollars on this year’s Super Bowl as an emerging industry of prediction markets and daily fantasy companies takes advantage of betting loopholes, according to the Dallas Morning News. item.title: Texas’ newest inspector general will target ‘educator misconduct’
item.description: AUSTIN – The Texas Education Agency this week named former assistant attorney general Levi Fuller as the state’s first Inspector General of Educator Misconduct. In the newly created role, Fuller will closely oversee TEA policies and processes to help “foster safe learning environments for the state’s 5.5 million public school students,” the agency’s announcement said. … Continue reading Texas’ newest inspector general will target ‘educator misconduct’

item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Trump administration said Friday that its use of emergency orders to keep aging coal-fired plants operating helped prevent a major blackout from power shortages during the brutally frigid weather that has gripped most of America for the past two weeks.
